summary: From a blank file you write compare_sizes.py: cut the guide at 25, 60 and 120 tokens, ask five questions, and print the chunks, the top 1 and top 3 hits, and the tokens sent. Then you read the two failures.
goal: Compare 3 chunk sizes on 5 questions, from a blank file.

items.text: Write down which size you think will win and which will send the most tokens
Write compare_sizes.py from the contract, without the solution
Run it and compare your table with the solution
Print the top 3 for a failing question and say why it failed
Play the Chunk Size Check game to the end and see your score
